metaDescription: Pro Windows won our 2026 Window & Door Installation award for Vaughan, Ontario. In-house manufacturing of casement, bay and slider windows and doors.
summary: Pro Windows manufactures and installs windows and doors from its Vaughan, Ontario facility, handling delivery and installation in-house rather than subcontracting. The product range spans casement, awning, slider, double-hung and bay windows, plus entry and patio doors.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: Pro Windows offers casement, awning, double-slider and bay windows, along with entry and patio doors. Because the company manufactures its own product line, it can typically offer more custom sizing options than a company that resells third-party window brands.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: Manufacturing and installation are handled in-house, from the same Vaughan facility, rather than the more common model of a retailer subcontracting installation to a third party. This structure can shorten communication between the factory and the install crew, which matters if a window arrives slightly out of spec and needs to be reordered.

editorial.heading: What to expect
editorial.text: No customer reviews are published for this listing yet, so ask the company directly for recent local references, particularly for a project similar in scope, such as a full-home window replacement or a single patio door swap. Ask to see their showroom or sample units before ordering custom sizes.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The company is based in and primarily serves Vaughan, Ontario. Homeowners outside Vaughan should confirm delivery and installation coverage before requesting a quote, since in-house manufacturing can mean a more limited install radius than a franchise dealer network.
